verdict.rationale: BigQuery documents its own 'BigQuery sandbox', which lets users explore limited capabilities at no cost without a billing account. That gives a separate, free environment to experiment in. However, the docs frame it as a trial or evaluation tier, not as an isolated test copy of production data. Dry-run cost estimation is a different capability and is not counted as sandbox isolation. Missing for 10: documentation that the sandbox isolates tests from production datasets, a way to clone or mirror production data into a test environment, agent-oriented sandbox workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: The BigQuery sandbox lets you explore limited BigQuery capabilities at no cost to confirm whether BigQuery fits your needs.
The BigQuery sandbox lets you experience BigQuery without providing a credit card or creating a billing account for your project.
